name: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat
description: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
